_doc: Orbiter geometry shared by the aero model (Python) and the visual model (JS). Body frame FRD: x forward, y right, z down; metres; origin = centre of gravity / moment reference point. Visual model local frame (three.js) = (x, -z, y). Only the right side (y>0) of symmetric parts is listed; mirror for the left side.

fuselage._doc: stations: [x, half_width, z_top, z_bot]; z_top negative (up). Cross-section ~ superellipse, flat bottom, rounded top. Nose tip at x=21.39, aft base at x=-11.38.

wing._doc: Exposed wing outboard of the fuselage side (y=2.6). Planform polyline in (x, y). Chord plane z at root = z_root, dihedral raises the plane outboard (z decreases). Reference trapezoid (for S/cbar) has root LE x=3.19 at y=0, 45 deg LE sweep, tip LE x=-8.70, TE root x=-14.32 (y=0) to tip x=-12.20.
wing._le_doc: glove/strake LE sweep 81 deg from (11.20,2.60) to (-1.53,4.72); main LE sweep 45 deg to the tip
wing._elevon_doc: hinge line parallel to the TE, chord measured streamwise from the TE. Left side names elevon_li / elevon_lo. Deflection positive = trailing edge DOWN.

rudder._doc: split rudder/speedbrake: two panels (left/right halves). rudder positive = trailing edge LEFT. Panel angles: left = rudder + sb/2, right = rudder - sb/2 (outward opening).

oms_pods._doc: visual + drag only. Each pod centred at y=+-2.25, from x=-1.0 to x=-11.6, z from -2.6 (bottom) to -4.6 (top)

engines._doc: SSME nozzle exits (visual): [x_mount, y, z], exit radius, length

gear._doc: wheel contact points (extended, unloaded) in FRD. Strut axis = body z.

drag_chute._doc: 40 ft conical ribbon chute. Riser attaches in the compartment at the base of the fin trailing edge, above SSME #1 (FRD). line_length = suspension lines skirt->confluence; pilot chute 9 ft on a bridle behind the vent.
